declaration: R2 uses engine-truth reward and termination, so it is a training-time privileged diagnostic: it is NOT strict pixel self-improvement (R1) and no result here may be reported as R1.

checkpoint_initial.warning: a second file with this name exists under T05/checkpoints and is a different model; reference by full path + sha256

death_penalty.counted: once per death, a first death does not end the episode

progress_total.unit: reward for traversing the whole first face by score
progress_total.counted: cumulative, hard-capped at progress_total per episode

progress_score_full.event: the score a real first-face clear reaches

survive_per_decision.unit: reward per decision at the two-frame beat
survive_per_decision.counted: 0.0: a bare survival constant is what §5 forbids, because at γ = 0.99889 the discounted sum of a constant c is c/(1-γ) ≈ 900·c and a long stall would out-earn a clear

progress_bound.meaning: a trajectory can never earn more than progress_total from progress, however long it stalls

discount.note: Δt = 2/60 s and τ = 30 s are the physical-clock definition; the old γ = 0.99 had a ~3.3 s scale and was not a statement about what the model can remember

trained: critic (Linear(128,1) on the frozen trunk output)

diag_first_death.paired_note: R2 batches may be fewer than R0's 20 if the engine queue was still running when the evidence was collected; the denominator is the number of pairs actually measured

s1n.paired_note: R2 batches may be fewer than R0's 20 if the engine queue was still running when the evidence was collected; the denominator is the number of pairs actually measured

cost_extrapolation.basis: measured on this host during the 50k pilot, under CPU contention

measured.mean_episode_frames_source: fallback: the audit's real argmax episode ended at 2,186 frames (the pilot's loop never finished one)

clean_host_alternative.source: the same tier's 13,195-frame real Stage-1 clear replay ran at 86.8 fps end to end

assumptions.reset_source: one engine start per episode; the same 5-7 s the frozen ruler pays, counted separately so the training throughput is not flattered
assumptions.contention: the pilot ran at load average ~26 with another collection job holding 8 cores, so its measured fps is a lower bound and the clean-host row is the honest planning number

three_seeds_serial.note: serial wall clock for 3 seeds × 1M game frames, the WP420-05 first tier; the GPU is not the constraint here, the engine and the CPU forward pass are

five_m_seeds.status: not scheduled and not budgeted: WP420-05 makes the 5M tier conditional on the numerics check and on ≥2/3 paired positive runs

notes: R2 uses engine-truth reward and termination, so it is a training-time privileged diagnostic: it is NOT strict pixel self-improvement (R1) and no result here may be reported as R1.
one seed at a 50,000-frame budget is a pilot: it is not the 1M-frame tier and a single seed is not three
the frozen ruler evaluates the trained checkpoint in argmax mode, so the deployment rule is the same one R0 is measured with
